title: The Onboarding Gap That's Quietly Costing You Clients
note: Render on the Mac: BlogAnnounce.tsx + the cloned voice. Output blog-announce-video.mp4 into this folder.

beats.vo: Most clients who leave actually decided to leave in the first 30 days.
Not because the work was bad — because the handoff felt chaotic.
A good onboarding system makes the right thing happen at the right time, automatically.
Start with a one-hour audit: write out what a new client gets in seven days.
The gaps will be obvious. Those are exactly where clients go quiet on you.
The full breakdown is on the blog — link is in the comments.
